citizens.name: Lena Ortiz
citizens.background: Keeps the Lantern cafe running for the early shift.
citizens.city_line: The cafe opens at eight. I close at seven, with a short break after half past twelve.
citizens.call_line: This is Lena at the Lantern. Stop by while I am at the counter. Coffee and sandwiches are on the menu.
